top_signals.title: FTSE 100 Live: Stocks eye recovery after bond sell-off; Oil holds over $100
top_signals.summary: Welcome back to the City AM liveblog. Markets are hoping to claw back some of last week’s losses to kick off the week after a global bond rout set ripples through the world’s top exchanges. Fears of an inflationary shock on the back of rising oil and diesel saw bond yields across the world’s economies spike. This [...]

top_signals.title: Gold Steady as Market Weighs US Jobs Data Impact on Fed Path
top_signals.summary: Gold was steady — after its biggest weekly drop since June — as traders weighed the impact of a slowdown in the US jobs market and elevated bond yields on the Federal Reserve’s rate path.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Braves bounce back with victory to pull even in NLDS against Dodgers
top_signals.summary: Michael Harris II went 3-for-5 with a triple and a double, scored one run and drove in another as the Braves head home in the best-of-five series with Game 3 on Tuesday.
